newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed unit wins $130 mln USPS contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed unit wins $130 mln USPS contract.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Federal Systems, a unit of Lockheed Martin Corp, said on Thursday it has won a contract valued at more than $130 million to deploy 11 production units of a computer-controlled material handling system, called the Tray Management System (TMS), for the U.S. Postal Service.
This is the second production buy of the Lockheed Martin TMS system, which the company said has a sales potential of $1 billion through the year 2000.

Lockheed Martin previously developed a prototype system at the Fort Lauderdale, Fla., U.S. Postal Service facility. In l996, the company said it was awarded a contract for the first four production deployments in West Palm Beach, Fla.; Orlando, Fla.; Baton Rouge, La. and San Antonio, Texas Processing and Distribution Centers.
